title: Valmont Industries
description: Leading UX/UI design for enterprise software at a global manufacturing company — bridging technical complexity with human-centered clarity.

hero.headline: Designing clarity into complex industrial software.

paragraphs: At Valmont Industries, I led UX/UI design for a suite of enterprise features — navigating the tension between deep technical requirements and the need for interfaces that non-technical users could move through with confidence.

phases.title: Discovery
phases.description: Understanding complex business logic through stakeholder workshops and onsite field research.

phases.title: UX Strategy
phases.description: Translating requirements into logical user flows and low-fidelity wireframes for rapid validation.

phases.title: High-Fi Design
phases.description: Applying the design system to create polished, accessible interfaces with a focus on data visualization.

phases.title: Handoff
phases.description: Comprehensive documentation and component specs for engineering teams in Dubai and globally.

applications.heading: Enterprise Design System
applications.description: A master design system standardizing 200+ UI components — bridging the gap between technical engineering requirements and human-centered design principles.

apps.name: Dashboard Redesign
apps.subtitle: From data-heavy legacy to actionable clarity

keyChanges.before: Industrial software suffering from feature-creep and legacy interface patterns that prioritized raw data over actionable insights
keyChanges.after: Design system handling massive data sets while remaining accessible to field operators who spend minutes at a time in the interface

apps.name: Alert System
apps.subtitle: Critical alerts never missed, workspace never overwhelmed

keyChanges.before: No clear prioritization of critical alerts — important signals lost in noise
keyChanges.after: Hierarchical alert system ensuring critical alerts are never missed while maintaining a workspace that doesn't overwhelm the user

keyChanges.before: Inconsistent UI patterns across features with no shared design language
keyChanges.after: 200+ UI components standardized into a master design system — 25% faster designer-to-developer handoff

keyChanges.before: 12 critical usability bottlenecks identified via Hotjar session recordings and Microsoft Clarity heatmaps
keyChanges.after: Bottlenecks resolved — 15% increase in task completion rates, 40% reduction in training time for 1,200+ internal users across MENA

outcome.quote: From requirements gathering and user flows to final prototypes, I owned the design process end-to-end while working closely with product managers and engineering teams to ship.

deliverables.title: Product Adoption
deliverables.description: Successfully rolled out the new interface to 1,200+ internal users across MENA, reducing training time by 40%.

deliverables.title: System Efficiency
deliverables.description: Standardized 200+ UI components into a master design system, increasing designer-to-developer handoff speed by 25%.

deliverables.title: UX Metrics
deliverables.description: Used Hotjar insights to fix 12 critical usability bottlenecks, leading to a 15% increase in task completion rates.

deliverables.title: Future Ready
deliverables.description: Implemented scalable patterns now serving as the foundation for the company's next-gen AI analytics dashboard.
